picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four projects under DOE's new Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science initiative spanning 300+ institutions — a signal of how deeply AI is being embedded in federal scientific infrastructure.

picks.editorial_note: A $10 million OpenAI Foundation grant (part of a $60 million investment) will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers — a concrete, large-scale humanitarian application of AI research.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to more than 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, showing how deeply AI vendors are embedding in university operations.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million naming gift establishing a dedicated College of Artificial Intelligence at UNT reflects the growing scale of private philanthropic investment in AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for a DOE-led 'Mine of the Future' award shows AI research expanding into critical-minerals and industrial applications with direct federal backing.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test of AI reasoning claims that the mathematics community is actively scrutinizing.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves roughly 100x higher storage density than binary approaches, a hardware advance that could meaningfully improve efficiency of AI-capable smart devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models — a practical step toward making generative design tools usable for real manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, University of Queensland and industry partners to make AI data-centre power loads dynamically grid-aware addresses a growing tension between AI compute demand and grid stability.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: Telkom Foundation, BCX and Alibaba Cloud's partnership with Wits University to give students access to AI development tools illustrates how global tech firms are shaping AI skills pipelines in emerging markets.
